verdict.rationale: Live probes show docs.kushki.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 as text/plain. It is a markdown docs index linking .md versions of the docs pages, and the .md pages themselves resolve (e.g., cl.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs. The quality is limited: the probed llms.txt entries have empty descriptions, and the .md pages contain inline HTML styling rather than clean markdown. missing for 10: descriptive llms.txt entries or an llms-full.txt, clean markdown without embedded HTML, first-party documentation of agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
